name: verifying a built artifact
from: A built thing believed working because its builders ran their own checks: verification a stage of the building, performed by the party whose schedule it threatens.
to: The artifact exercised by an office independent of its builders, up the ladder — the design verified against what was actually built, the parts integrated and exercised together, the whole exercised as its user would meet it — with the final verdict owed by the verifying office and not negotiable back down the line.
cost: A whole verification pass that duplicates none of the building and repairs nothing it finds — its independence is bought by exactly that refusal — plus the apparatus to exercise the artifact for real rather than read about it.
otherwise: The last party to touch the product before a user is the party most invested in shipping it; every defect found later than this office costs more than it would have here, and the ones users find cost trust that does not come back.
